product_metadata.title: MAGGIFT Memento Storage Boxes,Wooden Stub Shadow Box Tickets, Ticket Memory Box (Black)
features: HIGH QUALITY: This shadow box is made of solid wood frame with a satin and black finish, the strengthened glass cover makes this shadow box display case easy to view the shadow box's contents.
DECORATIVE FRAME: This wood shadow box frame with vintage look, decorated with a red classic backing, is a great match or addition to any home decor.

EASY TO USE: This shadow box display case is featured with 4 swivel tabs for easy opening and closing, makes it easy to place or update your display. It has a 3.9 inch ticket slot at the top of shadow box where you can drop in your tickets.

READY TO HANG: The ticket stub shadow box size is 10 inches in height, 8 inches wide, comes with a pre-installed hook on the back, can be hang on a wall, or proudly display it on a desktop, mantel or tabletop.

DECOR YOUR HOME: This memory box is the perfect box for protecting and displaying all of your fond memories, use it to store all your show tickets, concert tickets, travel tickets, engagement photos and movie stubs, it is also a great gift for all friends and family of all ages.
